sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New Overview page with status, health check and update card
  • Full-site backup and restore (database, uploads, plugins, themes) with notes about every backup
  • Restore on another domain with serialized-safe address replacement, using a standalone runner that keeps working while the database is replaced
  • Backup & restore merged with settings backups and export/import, with formal option names
  • Updates from this repository with checksum verification and an auto-update switch
  • Drag-and-drop file upload component
  • Menu stays open on sub-tabs; Forms page without tab bar
  • Refreshed Traditional Chinese translation
